[简体中文] Maps to -wrap+ / -wrap-. Unwraps lines to fit the target screen width.
[简体中文] Maps to -hy+ / -hy-. Preserves or strips line-end hyphens during text wrapping.
[简体中文] Maps to -j (-1 auto, 0 left, 1 center, 2 right, 3 full justification).
[简体中文] Maps to -r2l+ / -r2l-. Enables RTL word and column progression for Arabic, Persian, Urdu, and Hebrew.
[简体中文] Vertical CJK Text Layout
[简体中文] Enables right-to-left vertical column segmentation and CJK character spacing without Latin word gaps.
[简体中文] Maps to -ac. Automatically trims noisy borders and scanning artifacts.
[简体中文] Odd / Even Page Margins (-ml, -mr)
[简体中文] Maps to -ml, -mt, -mr, -mb with distinct gutter offsets for odd and even book pages.
[简体中文] Maps to -c. Increases foreground darkness relative to paper background.
[简体中文] Maps to -g. Values below 1.0 darken anti-aliased glyphs for crisp e-ink display.
[简体中文] Maps to -sh+ / -sh-. Applies unsharp masking to blurred scans.
[简体中文] Maps to -d+ / -d-. Tunes grayscale halftoning for 1-bit, 2-bit, or 4-bit e-ink panels (-bpc).
[简体中文] Applies Leptonica deskew (-as+), morphological despeckle, background whitening, and Sauvola shadow removal before 智能重排.
[简体中文] Intelligent Dark & E-Ink Inversion (-neg)
[简体中文] Maps to -neg / -neg+. Inverts page polarity while keeping figures legible.
[简体中文] Uses bundled neural layout detector (with classic k2pdfopt projection-profile fallback) to tag text, tables, figures, captions, equations, and footnotes.
[简体中文] Protected Tables, Figures & Equations
[简体中文] Prevents splitting or 智能重排ing tables, figures, and inline math formulas; offers scale-to-fit or keep-as-image.
[简体中文] Moves detected footnotes to the end of the citing paragraph, end of section, or keeps them in place.
[简体中文] Target File Size Limit (KB)
[简体中文] Iteratively tunes output DPI (-dpi) and bits-per-pixel (-bpc) to meet your target file size budget.
[简体中文] Exports searchable PDF, PNG/JPEG images, 智能重排able EPUB 3, semantic HTML5, Markdown, or UTF-8 TXT.
